scope: MILESTONE: the server can end a match and send the client back to the lobby via an OOB disconnect
server_change: gameserver supports --oob-command TEXT --oob-delay S; send_due_oob() is wired into both serve-loop branches
significance: this completes the 'return to lobby' half of the goal: the server now has a protocol-level way to take the client from state 10 back to state 0 (lobby/main menu) with the connection torn down
combined with the earlier cbuf test it confirms the client's leave-match path and gives us the server-side trigger
the OOB disconnect is reliable: state 0 remained stable at the +15s and +30s follow-up samples
next: package it as the end-of-match flow: send the OOB disconnect after a configured match duration
optionally precede it with an intermission signal (PS field 83) if a visible 'match over' screen is wanted
